title: Operators
description: Staff who create orders on behalf of {{market}} and their commission
descriptionFallback: Staff who create orders on behalf of your store and their commission

list.label: Operator list
list.emptyDescription: An operator creates orders on behalf of {{market}}. Add one and set a commission — earnings are recorded for every sold order.
list.emptyDescriptionFallback: An operator creates orders on behalf of your store. Add one and set a commission — earnings are recorded for every sold order.
list.notFoundDescription: Change the search or the status filter.

warning.singleTitle: Commission not set — no earnings recorded

warning.manyTitle: {{count}} operators have no commission — no earnings recorded

commissionForm.percentHint: 0 to 100, up to 2 decimals. Taken from the sold order price.

create.title: Add operator
create.descriptionFallback: New staff member for your store
create.name: Full name
create.passwordHint: At least 4 characters. The operator signs in with this phone and password.
create.percentHint: Of the sold order price, 0 to 100. Leave it empty to set later — until then no earnings are recorded.
create.fixedHint: Per sold order, 0 to {{max}}. Leave it empty to set later — until then no earnings are recorded.

errors.phoneTaken: This phone number is taken — enter another one
errors.passwordShort: Password must be at least 4 characters

create.failedText: Check the details and try again.
create.blocked: The store is blocked — operators can't be added
create.createdText: {{name}} can now sign in with this phone and password.
create.commissionFailedText: Set the commission for {{name}} again — until then no earnings are recorded.

commissionDialog.title: Commission
commissionDialog.unsetTitle: Commission not set — no earnings recorded

commissionDialog.sampleTextEmpty: From a sold order of <nw>{{price}}</nw> — enter a percentage
commissionDialog.howText: A fixed amount doesn't depend on the order price: a sold order of <nw>{{low}}</nw> and one of <nw>{{high}}</nw> earn the same amount.

commissionDialog.notFound: Operator not found — the list was refreshed

deleteDialog.notFound: Operator not found — it may have been deleted already.
